package.description: Automate generation of business reports & documents based on XML, XBRL, and SQL data in web & print formats

en-US.description: Automate generation of business reports & documents based on XML, XBRL, and SQL data in web & print formats
en-US.longDescription: StyleVision Server renders XML, SQL databases, and/or XBRL data into HTML, RTF, PDF, pure text, or Microsoft Word files based on StyleVision stylesheets and supporting design elements defined using StyleVision. Report designs can include dynamic content elements including tables and beautiful charts, images, bar codes, headers and footers, and much more.
en-US.name: Altova StyleVision Server

zh-CN.description: 实现基于 XML、XBRL 和 SQL 数据的业务报表与文档自动化生成，支持网页及印刷格式输出
